review_window.rule: For every team, begin at that team's first 2026 training-camp player report/check-in and retain all subsequent injury, PUP, NFI, IR, recovery, activation, practice-return and material role events through Week 1 lock.

state_resolution.rule: Earlier camp evidence remains in history, but a later verified injury/recovery/activation event supersedes the earlier CURRENT state. Models must consume the resolved current state while explainability may inspect the full chronology.
state_resolution.conflict_rule: When credible sources disagree, preserve both records, mark POSSIBLY_MATERIAL, and do not force a numeric assumption until resolved.

fallback: documented team/beat reporting when primary source lacks timing detail
source_policy.rule: Current availability must not depend on nflverse injury data for 2025+ because that feed is unavailable.

events.subject: Alvin Kamara
events.detail: Sprained MCL in practice; NFL reporting on Aug. 19 said expected to miss at least the next month, while NFL Network described a Grade 2 MCL sprain with an expected 4-6 week absence.
events.supersedes: Earlier camp role/availability evidence showing Kamara participating in passing-down work.

events.subject: Taylor Moton
events.detail: Carolina announced Moton would start camp on reserve/NFI because of a blood clot in his lung and was expected to miss the start of the 2026 regular season.

events.subject: Kenny McIntosh
events.detail: Placed on PUP while recovering from a torn ACL.

events.subject: Nick Emmanwori
events.detail: Placed on PUP after an ankle injury dating to the prior postseason; later recovery state must be reconciled before Week 1.

events.subject: Joe Mixon
events.detail: Placed on active/NFI at the opening of camp; subsequent availability must be chronologically resolved.

events.subject: Dameon Pierce
events.detail: Placed on active/PUP at camp opening; subsequent return/role evidence must be reconciled before Week 1.

events.subject: Tank Dell
events.detail: Placed on PUP while rehabbing his knee; team said there was no return timeline in the opening-camp report.

events.subject: Trent Brown
events.detail: Placed on PUP at camp opening; offensive-line availability can affect pressure, rushing efficiency and team scoring.

events.subject: Denico Autry / Derek Barnett / Foley Fatukasi / Kurt Hinish / Jimmie Ward
events.detail: Multiple defensive contributors opened camp on PUP, requiring player-by-player recovery reconciliation before the 2026 defensive prior is set.

events.subject: Jeremiyah Love
events.detail: NFL injury index reported a high ankle sprain and that he was unlikely to play again in preseason; Week 1 state requires final reconciliation.

events.subject: Breece Hall
events.detail: NFL injury index reports a camp groin strain followed by expectation he would be ready for Week 1; retain both injury and positive recovery evidence.

events.subject: Tucker Kraft
events.detail: NFL injury index reports return to team drills from knee injury; positive progression does not erase recovery/ramp uncertainty.

events.subject: Jordyn Tyson
events.detail: NFL injury index reports a hamstring injury expected to sideline him roughly two months.

events.subject: Jayden Higgins
events.detail: NFL injury index reports a torn ACL and season-ending absence.

events.subject: Tyler Biadasz
events.detail: NFL injury index reports an ACL injury during practice with an indefinite absence.

required_backfill.closure_rule: Step 6.5B cannot close until every team has been reviewed from its camp opening through the post-cutdown Week 1 roster/injury state.
